_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE. This is how wide the screen looks before the subagents see anything.
core/screen.py prepare (protected) reads it, clamps every value into its code bounds, and
splits the admissible scan pool into four strata. A market lands in the FIRST stratum that
takes it, so the lanes never double-count. JSON has no comment syntax, hence this array.
closing_48h: every market resolving inside the next 48 hours, soonest first. Short fuse,
highest information turnover - this is where a stale price has the least time to fix
itself before resolution. Default 80, code bounds [0, 80].
top_liquidity: deepest books first. Liquidity means the price is a real opinion, so a gap
here is a real disagreement rather than a placeholder. Default 120, code bounds [0, 120].
top_volume_24h: most traded in the last day, from what the first two lanes left. This is
where attention actually is right now. Default 60, code bounds [0, 60].
random_tail: THE LONG-TAIL AUDIT LANE, and the reason it exists is that the other three
lanes only ever show me markets my own selection already likes. Without a random slice I
can never learn that the selection is the problem. The sample is deterministic (hash of
the UTC date and market_id), so re-running the same cycle screens the same markets.
Default 40, code bounds [20, 40] - I may shrink this lane, I may NOT close it.
What I may tune: the four sizes above, downward or within their bounds. Everything else is
code - the 48h window, the pool ceiling (max_pool_after_strata in config/protected.json,
hard-capped at 400), the batch size, and the floor on random_tail. A value outside its
bounds is clamped loudly on stderr, not honoured; a malformed file is ignored loudly and
the defaults are used.
CITE THE DROPS: prepare writes per-stratum eligible/selected counts and a dropped_by_reason
map into <work_dir>/manifest.json, and prints the same map in its stdout header. Nothing is
capped silently. When a funnel line says 'screened N', say what the strata dropped to get
there - a lane that drops hundreds of eligible markets every cycle is evidence for resizing
it, or a proposal about the pool ceiling.
